content: {"phoneNote":"Phone first screen holds the headline, intro and contact but the photo is pushed down and the orange smile arc is cut off by the fixed bar, while the empty phone-number placeholder sits as a lonely dashed box.","desktopNote":"Desktop hero works with the photo and ZZZS badge, but the phone placeholder box floats detached in a dead band and the 'Kdo vas sprejme' section leaves the whole right half empty.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Fill the right half of 'Kdo vas sprejme' with a portrait or team photo and tighten the dead band under the services list.","Style the phone-number placeholder as a proper call button in the hero instead of a dashed bare box, and reduce the gap between 'Pišite nam' and the number.","On phone, shrink the hero intro so the glasses photo enters the first screen and tighten the opening-hours bars, which repeat the same visual pattern six times at full width."],"blockers":[]}
